title: Invite a co-parent
note: The sheet carries the book's cover: the invite is into this book. What the child calls them, in the letter face with the same ideas as first run, signs their letters, and the cover's foot line reads "From Papa" once the typing pauses. The invite is for this book only; the link works once, for 7 days.
